Heritance Art & Craft in Andheri West has a vast catalogue of furniture pieces to cater to residences as well as office spaces. You can shop for a wide range of office furniture such as executive chairs. This establishment is also into designing, installing and support services for modular kitchens through kitchen-by-design service. On the premises is a team of sales staff that help you in shortlisting from their furniture range according to your needs and requirements.

featured_reviews.name: Nirav Doshi
featured_reviews.review_text:
​I am beyond disappointed with my experience. We purchased an expensive sofa under the explicit promise from the salesperson Deepu Tilwani that it was made with high-quality Italian leather. This turned out to be a complete lie.
​Within just one year, the "leather" has already started to peel off, exposing the poor quality of the material. To make matters worse, the recliner motor has already failed, making the sofa practically useless. It is clear now that they are selling cheap, low-grade products while charging premium prices.
​The most infuriating part has been the lack of after-sales support. The salesperson, who was so eager to make "promises" during the sale, has completely stopped answering my calls and messages. Once they have your money, they disappear.
​Save your money and go elsewhere. This company is dishonest, their products are subpar, and they do not stand behind what they sell. They are nothing more than a scam.

A Century of Timeless Treasures
Stepping into this century-old antique shop is like stepping back in time. The creaking floorboards and dusty shelves are filled with a treasure trove of history. From vintage furniture to delicate porcelain, every item tells a story.
The shop's knowledgeable staff is always on hand to provide insights into the history and provenance of their pieces. Their passion for antiques is evident in their enthusiasm and expertise.
Whether you're a seasoned collector or simply looking for a unique piece to add to your home, this antique shop is a must-visit. It's a place where you can discover the beauty and charm of the past.

featured_reviews.name: Sheldon Dias
featured_reviews.review_text:
Located in the St. Pauls Media Complex, St Paul Book And Art Centre Mumbai is a serene landmark that serves as a one-stop destination for spiritual literature and religious artifacts. It is particularly well-regarded for its peaceful, library-like atmosphere, offering a quiet refuge for visitors to browse through a wide range of specialized materials.
• Diverse Collection: The store is a major hub for religious and spiritual books, including Bibles in various editions, theological texts, and Catholic literature, as well as academic titles, CBSE textbooks, and children's storybooks.
• Art and Gifts: Beyond literature, it features an extensive selection of religious artifacts, such as statues, rosaries, candles, and framed prints, making it a popular spot for meaningful gifts and church supplies.
• Holiday Highlights: During the Christmas season, the first floor transforms into a festive destination stocked with unique décor, souvenirs, and seasonal ornaments.
• Supportive Environment: Visitors frequently mention the well-organized layout and the helpful, professional staff who are knowledgeable about the inventory and assist with niche title requests.

featured_reviews.name: Sorab Gupta
featured_reviews.review_text:
The gallery space is ok. The juxtaposition of the outside streets and traffic with the clean, straight and white walls and black ground is a different experience altogether.

The exhibition of shinde and harshavardhana - sacred, symmetry and sense, initially seemed trivial. However, as I read about the artists and their journey and stayed with the pieces I began to enjoy and find connection with them on the inside.

A note to the gallery owner - i had a hard time convincing the guards to not shut down the air and airconditioner and allow me to use the restroom. But they were in such a rush to close before the timing at 6.15 instead of 7 pm that I got really annoyed and frustrated. They shut the AC down and didn't let me use the restroom....sadly.
